12 Entry Points — NCA Organised Crime

Entry Point 01

Serious Organised Crime

Drug trafficking networks, firearms supply, OCG disruption operations, county lines exploitation, modern slavery and human trafficking. NCA leads UK SOC strategy through tasking and coordination of NCA, police, and partner agencies against the highest-harm organised crime groups.

Entry Point 02

Economic Crime

Fraud (including APP fraud, investment fraud, romance scams), money laundering via UKFIU SAR regime (2.4M+ SARs/yr), asset recovery through ARO/POCA frameworks, bribery and corruption investigations. NCA Economic Crime Command targets professional enablers and laundering infrastructure.

Entry Point 03

Cyber Crime

National Cyber Crime Unit operations — ransomware response, business email compromise, dark web marketplace disruption, botnet takedowns, cryptocurrency seizure under POCA. NCA coordinates with NCSC on critical national infrastructure protection and international cyber partnerships.

Entry Point 04

Child Exploitation

CEOP command — online child sexual abuse detection, grooming pattern analysis, indecent image identification at scale, victim identification and safeguarding. NCA child protection operations work with international partners to disrupt CSA networks and rescue victims across jurisdictions.

Entry Point 05

Immigration Crime

Clandestine entry facilitation networks, small boats Channel crossings, NCA/Border Force joint operations targeting organised immigration crime groups. Intelligence-led disruption of facilitators, logistics networks, and financial flows underpinning illegal migration to the UK.

Entry Point 06

Border Policing

UK port security — freight screening, postal interception, cash courier detection, Border Crime Policing liaison officers at major ports. NCA coordinates with Border Force on high-risk consignments, containerised drug imports, and firearms concealment across maritime and aviation routes.

Entry Point 07

Intelligence

UKHTC (Human Trafficking Centre), CHIS handling under RIPA, INTERPOL/Europol coordination, Five Eyes intelligence sharing, covert surveillance authorisation. NCA intelligence infrastructure underpins all operational commands with classified and sensitive source material.

Entry Point 08

Proceeds of Crime

Asset confiscation orders, civil recovery under POCA, unexplained wealth orders (UWOs), cash seizure at borders, account freezing orders. NCA Proceeds of Crime Command targets criminal wealth with financial investigation as a core disruption tool against OCGs.

Entry Point 09

Firearms & Explosives

NABIS (ballistics intelligence), illegal firearms trafficking, IED precursor supply chains, explosive importation detection. NCA works with regional ROCUs and international partners to disrupt weapons pipelines from source to street-level criminal use across the UK.

Entry Point 10

International Cooperation

NCA liaison officers posted globally, mutual legal assistance treaties (MLATs), joint investigation teams (JITs), fugitive extradition under UK Extradition Act 2003. International partnerships are central to NCA's ability to pursue transnational organised crime beyond UK borders.

Entry Point 11

Threat Assessment

NCA Strategic Assessment, National Tasking Force Process (NTFP), UK threat picture from serious organised crime, county lines mapping and hotspot analysis. Threat assessment drives NCA operational priorities and resource allocation through evidence-based strategic planning.

Entry Point 12

Parliamentary & Governance

NCA Director General accountability, oversight by Intelligence and Security Committee (ISC), Home Affairs Select Committee (HASC), annual plan publication, HMICFRS inspection regime. Governance structures ensure NCA operates within legal mandate and democratic accountability.

8 Transformation Priorities

Priority 01

OCG Network Disruption Intelligence

AI-powered network mapping and social graph analysis to visualise OCG hierarchies, identify key nominals, and predict disruption leverage points. Integrates CHIS intelligence, financial data, and communications data to build comprehensive OCG profiles. Target: network mapping time weeks→hours, disruption operations 40% faster.

Priority 02

Economic Crime Detection Engine

Automated SAR triage and prioritisation across 2.4M+ annual submissions, anomaly detection for fraud typologies, money laundering pattern recognition, and professional enabler identification. Target: SAR analysis 2.4M→prioritised actionable cases, fraud detection rates +60%.

Priority 03

Cyber Crime Automated Response

Rapid ransomware containment and attribution, dark web marketplace monitoring, cryptocurrency blockchain analysis for seizure, automated botnet infrastructure mapping and takedown coordination. Target: ransomware containment 72h→4h, crypto seizure rate +80%.

Priority 04

Child Exploitation AI Shield

Advanced image and video analysis for CSA material detection at scale, grooming pattern recognition in online communications, victim identification acceleration through biometric and contextual matching. Target: CSA image detection accuracy 95%→99.5%, victim identification time -70%.

Priority 05

Border Intelligence Fusion

Multi-modal threat detection at UK ports — freight manifest analysis, passenger risk scoring, cash courier identification, clandestine entry pattern recognition. Integrates Border Force and NCA intelligence streams. Target: threat detection at ports 30%→70%, freight risk scoring automated.

Priority 06

Proceeds of Crime Recovery Accelerator

Automated financial investigation, hidden asset identification, UWO case preparation, cross-border asset tracing. AI-assisted civil recovery and confiscation order preparation to maximise criminal asset recovery. Target: asset recovery value +50%, UWO processing 12mo→3mo.

Priority 07

International Cooperation Platform

Digital MLAT processing, JIT coordination workspace, evidence sharing automation, fugitive tracking intelligence fusion. Secure platform for real-time collaboration with INTERPOL/Europol and Five Eyes partners. Target: MLAT processing 6mo→6wk, JIT coordination time -60%.

Priority 08

Threat Assessment Automation

Automated NCA Strategic Assessment production from multi-source intelligence, real-time SOC threat mapping, county lines hotspot prediction, resource allocation optimisation based on threat picture. Target: Strategic Assessment production 4wk→1wk, real-time SOC mapping enabled.

🚫 6 Red Lines — Non-Negotiable Governance Boundaries

  • 1. Covert Surveillance: No covert surveillance authorised without RIPA/IPC warrant — all CHIS and interception requires judicial authorisation.
  • 2. Child Exploitation Images: No child exploitation image processed by AI without NCA CEOP officer human review at decision point.
  • 3. Asset Seizure: No asset seizure without POCA court order — algorithmic flagging only; confiscation requires judicial process.
  • 4. Intelligence Sharing: No intelligence shared with foreign agencies without NCA Director General authorisation and data protection assessment.
  • 5. Facial Recognition: No automated facial recognition deployed at border without Home Secretary approval and DPIA.
  • 6. Disruption Operations: No disruption operation authorised without Gold Commander — all tactical operations require human chain of command.

✅ 5-Step Engagement Model

1
Discovery
NCA operational audit — map current intelligence workflows, identify automation opportunities across SOC, economic crime, cyber, and child protection commands. Assess RIPA/POCA compliance posture and data governance maturity.
2
Governance Design
Co-design Article 50-compliant governance framework — define red lines, human-in-the-loop protocols, CHIS handling safeguards, and POCA judicial process gates aligned with NCA accountability structures.
3
Pilot
Deploy 2-3 MCP servers in controlled NCA pilot environment — OCG network mapping, SAR triage, or cyber response. Measure against KPIs: time-to-disruption, detection rates, asset recovery value.
4
Scale
Roll out to additional NCA commands — border policing, child protection, international cooperation. Integrate with existing NCA systems (Jigsaw, HOLMES2, financial investigation platforms).
5
Assure
Continuous governance assurance — Article 50 compliance monitoring, HMICFRS inspection readiness, red line audit trail, NCA Director General reporting dashboards, annual governance review.
